summary: Describes sixteen new TLS cipher suites using elliptic curve cryptography that specify stronger message authentication than the HMAC-SHA-1 used earlier. Eight use HMAC with SHA-256 or SHA-384, and eight use AES in Galois Counter Mode. They give TLS 1.2 users stronger options for elliptic-curve key exchange.

eli5.summary: It adds sixteen new combinations of locks and seals for secure web connections, so people who like small, fast elliptic-curve keys can pick stronger tamper-checking too.
